messages:
sam: Proposal: combine route + quota headers into one negotiated header `Redwood-Route: v=2;enc=b64;d=...` to reduce proxy lookups.

linh: Can you show a concrete example and size expectations? SDKs need to know decode steps.

sam: Example payload (base64) decodes to `{"policy":"narrowcast","quota":"standard"}`. Keep pre-encode <=512 bytes.

elena: Edge concern: base64 adds ~33% size. Make v2 optional and fall back to v1 when over size limits or server doesn't advertise support.

maya: Console needs canonical keys for tiles: policy, quota, affinity (optional). Provide enum lists.

omar: Console can add per-customer opt-in toggle to test v2. We'll expose admin API + audit logs.

linh: SDK plan: implement encoder/decoder, negotiation via `Redwood-Server-Flags` returned on init or ping, cache flags per-host, gate behind `route.v2.enabled` feature flag default=false. Minor semver bump.

elena: Tests: proxy that simulates 4KB header limit, server toggling `route-v2` false after true. Security: never log decoded payload, avoid PII in affinity.

linh: Telemetry: emit `sdk.route.header.format` values `v1_emitted|v2_emitted|negotiated_v2|fallback_v1` and `sdk.route.header.size_bytes`. Sample 100% for first 2 weeks.

sam: I'll publish the spec and PR. Keep server parser backward compatible during rollout.

deploy-bot: preflight OK for `eng-platform/route-v2-spec` PR 6012 by sam.

maya: Good, @linh start SDK branches and post links. We'll watch telemetry closely.
